rationale: C17 is the strongest concrete template. It uses the same three-recital sequence, the same four named railway labor organizations, the same multi-State and large-portion-of-the-country transportation predicate, and the same two operative provisions requiring a report within thirty days and preserving the status quo through thirty days after the report. The child principally adapts that text from one railroad and one dispute to the Texas & Pacific system, its subsidiaries, and multiple disputes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: certain of their employees represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers, Brotherhood of Locomotive Firemen and Enginemen, Order of Railway Conductors and Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, labor organizations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers, the Brotherhood of Locomotive Firemen and Enginemen, the Order of Railway Conductors, and the Brotherhood of Railroad Trainmen, labor organizations
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive set of four labor organizations appears in essentially the same sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: these disputes, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board threaten substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within several States to a degree such as to deprive a large portion of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: this dispute, in the judgment of the national Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce within several States to a degree such as to deprive a large portion of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The factual and legal predicate is nearly verbatim, with only singular-to-plural adaptation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said disputes within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The reporting provision is copied in substance and adapted to multiple disputes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made ... in the conditions out of which the said disputes arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made ... in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The same statutory status-quo mechanism and operative sequence are retained nearly verbatim.
